description: Give a VPS more CPU, memory or disk — the answer to "my server is too small". Pass the service_id and the NEW sizes: cpu_cores, memory_gb, disk_gb (leave out any that stay as they are). Sizes only go up; a VPS cannot be made smaller. The price is what the billing system pro-rates to the next due date, paid from the account credit balance, which must already cover it (top up first with impreza_topup); from the next renewal the VPS bills at its new size. The new CPU count and memory reach the VPS when it is restarted with impreza_vps_power action=reboot — a reboot from inside the server keeps the old ones; the disk is enlarged at once. For the configurable VPS only — a fixed plan such as Tor Hosting changes plan with impreza_upgrade_service. Requires the "manage" scope. Returns order_id, invoice_id, amount, the sizes before and after, and when they take effect. If confirm_token is absent from this connection's input schema, use a connection that exposes it or a supported customer-portal flow. A quote or confirmation request is not completion. COSTS MONEY — takes two calls: the first is a QUOTE that charges nothing and returns the price plus a confirm_token, the second repeats the same arguments plus confirm_token and buys. Purchases also count against a daily spend ceiling on the credential.

cpu_cores.description: New vCPU count: at least the current one, inside the range impreza_vps_offer lists.

disk_gb.description: New SSD disk in GB: at least the current size, inside the range impreza_vps_offer lists.

max_amount.description: The most this resize may cost, in the account currency — the quoted due_today, e.g. "3.50".

memory_gb.description: New memory in GB: at least the current amount, inside the range impreza_vps_offer lists.

name: impreza_vps_resize
title: Resize a VPS
